title: नमक की खान का खौफनाक सच #shorts
topic: राजस्थान की प्राचीन नमक की खान और रात की शिफ्ट के 3 जानलेवा नियम
description: राजस्थान की वीरान नमक की खान में रात की ड्यूटी पर मिले तीन अजीब नियम और एक ऐसा सच जो रोंगटे खड़े कर दे। देखिए रात के किस्से का यह नया एपिसोड। #shorts #horrortories #haunted

characters.Rohan: Rohan: 26 years old, sharp lean face, piercing dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, medium height and athletic build, wearing a faded navy blue canvas jacket over a grey t-shirt and rugged cargo trousers, Indian look.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: राजस्थान की इस बंद नमक की खान में रात दो बजे के बाद तीन अजीब नियम क्यों माने जाते हैं?
scenes.visual: Rohan: 26 years old, sharp lean face, piercing dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, medium height and athletic build, wearing a faded navy blue canvas jacket over a grey t-shirt and rugged cargo trousers, Indian look. Rohan standing at the massive rusted iron gate of an underground salt mine in Rajasthan at midnight, holding a flickering torch, cold eerie blue lighting, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: M
scenes.text: पहला नियम... नमक की सफेद दीवारों पर कभी अपनी परछाई मत देखना!
scenes.style: nervous, breathy whisper, looking sideways in fear
scenes.visual: Rohan: 26 years old, sharp lean face, piercing dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, medium height and athletic build, wearing a faded navy blue canvas jacket over a grey t-shirt and rugged cargo trousers, Indian look. Rohan inside the dark damp salt tunnel, shining torch on glittering white salt walls, avoiding a strange shadow cast beside him, medium close-up, dramatic side lighting.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: लेकिन सुरक्षा गार्ड रोहन ने जैसे ही टॉर्च की रोशनी नीचे डाली, उसके रोंगटे खड़े हो गए।
scenes.visual: Rohan: 26 years old, sharp lean face, piercing dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, medium height and athletic build, wearing a faded navy blue canvas jacket over a grey t-shirt and rugged cargo trousers, Indian look. Rohan staring down with wide panicked eyes at the ground, holding the flickering torch tightly, underground salt mine corridor, low-angle medium shot.

scenes.speaker: M
scenes.text: दूसरा नियम... अगर पीछे से कोई आपका नाम पुकारे, तो मुड़कर बिल्कुल मत देखना!
scenes.visual: Rohan: 26 years old, sharp lean face, piercing dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, medium height and athletic build, wearing a faded navy blue canvas jacket over a grey t-shirt and rugged cargo trousers, Indian look. Rohan facing forward inside the narrow salt mine tunnel, sweat on forehead, looking tense and stiff, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: तभी... अंधेरे गलियारे से किसी ने बहुत धीमी आवाज में उसका नाम पुकारा— रोहन!
scenes.visual: Rohan: 26 years old, sharp lean face, piercing dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, medium height and athletic build, wearing a faded navy blue canvas jacket over a grey t-shirt and rugged cargo trousers, Indian look. Rohan freezing in his tracks, listening intently toward the dark empty salt tunnel ahead, moody shadows, wide angle.

scenes.speaker: M
scenes.text: तीसरा और आखिरी नियम... तीसरी सीढ़ी पर खड़े होकर कभी मत पूछना कि तुम कौन हो!
scenes.style: out of breath, panting heavily as if just ran for life
scenes.visual: Rohan: 26 years old, sharp lean face, piercing dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, medium height and athletic build, wearing a faded navy blue canvas jacket over a grey t-shirt and rugged cargo trousers, Indian look. Rohan running frantically up the old salt-crusted underground stairs, flashlight beam bouncing wildly, panic-stricken face, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: रोहन ने गलती से पूछ लिया— कौन है वहाँ? और जवाब में सीढ़ियों से उतरने लगी एक सफेद साया!
scenes.visual: Rohan: 26 years old, sharp lean face, piercing dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, medium height and athletic build, wearing a faded navy blue canvas jacket over a grey t-shirt and rugged cargo trousers, Indian look. Rohan looking back in absolute terror as a tall hazy white silhouette descends the salt mine stairs, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, close-up.

scenes.speaker: M
scenes.text: अरे नहीं! ये परछाई तो मेरी नहीं है... तो फिर बाहर कौन खड़ा है?
scenes.style: screaming in horror, desperate and trapped
scenes.visual: Rohan: 26 years old, sharp lean face, piercing dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, medium height and athletic build, wearing a faded navy blue canvas jacket over a grey t-shirt and rugged cargo trousers, Indian look. Rohan trapped against the heavy locked iron gate of the salt mine, banging his fists in despair, face pale with fear, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: नमक की खान का दरवाजा बाहर से बंद हो चुका था, और अंदर कोई और भी सांस ले रहा था!
scenes.style: dark, haunting whisper leaving a chilling cliffhanger
scenes.visual: Rohan: 26 years old, sharp lean face, piercing dark brown eyes, short messy black hair, medium height and athletic build, wearing a faded navy blue canvas jacket over a grey t-shirt and rugged cargo trousers, Indian look. Rohan standing paralyzed in complete darkness inside the salt mine, only two glowing eyes visible in the far corner, eerie cinematic dark blue tone, wide shot.
